scope: Experimental renderer canonical style ownership; C++ adapters remain transitional.

operations.behavior: Safe Arc style values own raw UTF16/f64 data and canonical rectangle references. Weak entries preserve MSVC bucket traversal and non-reflexive counted entries; later expired-key access returns an unresolved outcome.

Typed checked resources return separate owner ID, canonical identity and encoded length. Decode copies all input before registry admission or writes. Reads encode detached style packets; stale/wrong-kind/short output fails without writes.

Style and rectangle release accounting runs under admission. Removed resource destruction follows outside the registry guard, including unresolved release. Complete calls remain serialized by the native gate.

Shared wrapper holds only checked handle, identity and packet length. get returns a detached STSStyle. Assignment interns before releasing its old owner; copied and moved wrappers preserve aliases. Canonical data is Rust owned.
Experimental overlay hashing binds the detached style snapshot and copies the original low four blur bytes; no address of a temporary field is retained.

boundary_review.contract: Caller supplies live initialized input and writable output spans. Inputs may be unaligned or overlap output. No native style pointer or canonical rectangle reference crosses the boundary.

limits: Finite default-environment integration evidence, not whole-library completion or a production-default switch.
Nondefault floating modes/traps, allocator failure/reentry and whole-renderer concurrency remain unclosed.
Native NaN count after release is preserved with weak entries; later expired-key access is explicitly unresolved and never counted as a matching reference outcome.
C++ wrappers remain transitional. Fonts, word/line/subtitle graphs, rendering, all hosts and vendored implementations remain in scope.
